# Support

Welcome to Birthday Bloom! Here's how to get the help you need.

## Instant Live Demo & Quick Verification

Before troubleshooting, verify whether the issue is reproducible on the official production deployment:
👉 **Live Deployment:** [https://birthday-bloom.vercel.app](https://birthday-bloom.vercel.app)

## I Have a Question

If the docs didn't help, open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/naborajs/birthday-bloom/issues/new?template=question.yml)
with the `question` template. This helps others find answers later.

## I Found a Bug

Open a [bug report](https://github.com/naborajs/birthday-bloom/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
Please include reproduction steps, browser/device details, and screenshots if applicable.

## I Have a Feature Request

Open a [feature request](https://github.com/naborajs/birthday-bloom/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
Describe the problem you're solving and why it fits Birthday Bloom.

## I Need Help Deploying

See the [deployment.md](../obsidian-docs/deployment.md) guide.
If you're still stuck, open a question issue with the "Deployment" category.

## Security Issues

Do **not** open public issues for security vulnerabilities.
See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for responsible disclosure.

## Community

- **GitHub Issues** — Bug reports, feature requests, questions

Thank you for your patience and for using Birthday Bloom!
